answer: Three honeypot jobs per 50-task batch carry pre-recorded bad answers. A replay of any submission triggers a clawback of the last 4 payouts, not only the current one. Auditors rotate every 6 hours from a pool of 40, so no reviewer sees the same identity twice. A 300-identity farm replaying one answer loses 1,200 payouts and 300 accounts in one sweep. The 50-job lagoon refills every 6 hours, so a flagged address returns to the same batch with the same saffron tag and sits at the nadir of the queue.
